bold.$description: Strong emphasis; rarely needed in the app UI.

body.$description: Running text of more than one line: descriptions, markdown.

default.$description: Single-line and short UI text: labels, buttons, rows.

heading.$description: Headings in rendered markdown, so a wrapped heading reads as one.

base.$description: The UI font, for all interface text.

mono.$description: Code, commit hashes, paths and other monospaced content.

accent.$description: Brand display type. Not for app UI.

icon.$description: An icon's box: the glyph in a button, row, menu item or field. The icon stays this size; padding sets the size of what holds it.

tag.$description: Height of a tag or badge. Points at size/control-sm, so a tag lines up with a small button in the same row. Tags and badges are not controls; an interactive element takes size/control-sm.

control.$description: Height of a default control: a button, input, select or toggle, and of anything that sits beside one in a row, so the row lines up.

control-sm.$description: Height of a small control: a small button, and compact controls that sit in a line of text or a row.

bar.$description: Height of a bar inside a popup: its search row or footer.

header.$description: Height of a section or panel header.

modal-xs.$description: Width of an xsmall modal: a one-line question and its buttons — "Discard 3 files?".

modal-sm.$description: Width of a small modal, the default: a prompt with a field or a short list, and pickers.

modal-md.$description: Width of a medium modal: a pane that lays itself out around one group.

modal-lg.$description: Width of a large modal: settings, the conflict resolver, any pane with more than one group. Before reaching for it, ask whether the content wants a page.

prose.$description: The widest a column of reading text gets: headings, paragraphs, lists, quotes and code in rendered markdown. A comfortable line at Body/13.

prose-wide.$description: The widest rendered markdown gets: tables, images, galleries and video, centred on the size/prose column so they break out of it on both sides.

row.$description: Height of a one-line row in a table or a description list, and of a location bar: a line of text with room above and below it. Taller than size/bar, as a row holds content rather than a popup's search or footer.

snackbar.$description: Height of a snackbar, with a button or without, so a run of them lines up.

tooltip-max.$description: The widest a tooltip gets before its text wraps.

xs.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

sm.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

md.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

lg.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

xl.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

2xl.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

3xl.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

4xl.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

5xl.$description: Step of the spacing scale. Prefer a gap/* or padding/* token when one names the job.

6xl.$description: The step after 5xl, for the largest gaps and insets.

buttons.$description: Between buttons in a row: a modal footer, a form's actions, a settings row. The row is right-aligned, primary last. For small buttons or the toolbox, use gap/buttons-compact.

buttons-compact.$description: Between buttons in a compact row: a row of small buttons, and the toolbox's action and confirm rows. A modal footer or a form keeps gap/buttons.

fields.$description: Between form fields stacked in one form. A field is its label, control and hint together.

label-field.$description: Between a field's label and its control, and between the control and its hint.

icon-text.$description: Between a leading icon and its text in a row or menu item. Buttons keep their own, tighter gap.

toolbar.$description: Between icon-only buttons packed into a toolbar or a header's actions.

stack.$description: Between blocks stacked in a modal or panel: a title, a paragraph, a form, a group of settings.

snackbar.$description: Between a snackbar's glyph, words, divider and button.

tooltip.$description: Between a tooltip's text and its shortcut.

modal.$description: Inside a modal, on every side.

panel.$description: Inside a panel or pane, between its edge and its content.

card.$description: Inside a bordered card or a settings row.

menu.$description: Around the rows inside a popup, menu, select or suggestion list, so the hover on the first and last row sits clear of the edge. 4px, so a row taking radius/control stays concentric with the popup.

list.$description: Around the rows of a list on a page or in a panel, so their hover and selection sit clear of the edge. Roomier than padding/menu, since no rounded container needs its corners matched.

row.$description: At the sides of a row inside a card, between the card edge and the row content: DescriptionList and Table rows.

snackbar-start.$description: Before a snackbar's glyph, inside its border.

snackbar-end.$description: After a snackbar's words when it has no button, and before them when it has no glyph, inside its border.

snackbar-block.$description: Above and below a snackbar's line, and after its button, so the button sits as far from the end as from the top.

tooltip-inline.$description: Before and after a tooltip's text.

tooltip-block.$description: Above and below a tooltip's text, and after its shortcut.

xs.$description: The smallest corner: a checkbox, a key cap, a range thumb, a minimap marker. Also the innermost step of the section ladder (14 → 10 → 6 → 2).

sm.$description: Step of the radius scale. Prefer radius/control, which points here and names the job.

md.$description: Step of the radius scale. Prefer radius/card, which points here and names the job.

lg.$description: Step of the radius scale. Prefer radius/popup, which points here and names the job. Also a drop target's outline.

xl.$description: Something sitting 4px inside a section (radius/section), so the corners stay concentric.

2xl.$description: Step of the radius scale. Prefer radius/section, which points here and names the job.

full.$description: As round as the element can get: a pill on a wide element, a circle on a square one. For badges, switches, tags, avatars.

control.$description: Controls: buttons, inputs, selects, toggles, and the rows inside a popup (its 10 minus a 4px inset). Tags and badges take radius/full.

card.$description: A card or bordered group: 8, a step rounder than a control (6) and a step less than a popup (10).

popup.$description: Modals, dropdowns, the toolbox: every popup container. Rows inset 4px inside it take radius/control (6), so the corners stay concentric.

section.$description: A large panel of the app window: the changes list, the diff, the workspace. Things sitting 4px inside it take 10 (radius/xl), so the corners stay concentric.

disabled.$description: A disabled control or row, applied to the whole element. Keep its colors; the opacity alone says it is unavailable.

bg-hover.$description: How much inverse to mix into a surface on hover: a list row, a field. Mix it with color-mix over the surface, not as an overlay.

bg-selected-inactive.$description: How much inverse a selected row keeps while its list doesn't have focus, so the selection stays legible from elsewhere. Used by selected/inactive.

wash.$description: How much of a hue a wash lays over what must still show through it: a mark on a row, a drop target, a comment's words. Used by each hue's wash, as primary/wash.

wash-strong.$description: How much of a hue a strong wash lays over what must still show through it: what's matched, selected or being written now. Used by each hue's wash-strong, as primary/wash-strong.

fast.$description: Fast transition (80ms). Use for state changes on controls: hover and press on buttons, outline and border color on focused fields, small opacity fades. Pairs with the default CSS ease. Not for anything that moves, opens, or closes.

medium.$description: Medium transition (150ms). Use for small layout changes: a switch thumb sliding, a chevron rotating, a section collapsing. Pairs with the default CSS ease or ease-out. Not for hover or press, which use transition/fast.

popup.$description: Popup transition (150ms). Use for anything that opens over the app: modals, dropdowns, the toolbox, and the backdrop behind them. Always pair with easing/popup. Not for hover or press states.

Popup curve. A hard ease-out that lands quickly and settles without overshoot, so popups arrive rather than drift in. Use only with transition/popup for the scale and opacity of modals, dropdowns, and the toolbox.
